historical_independent_inputs.description: Independent twenty-family numeric path audit authored before Ground codec table
Reviewed public12 contract afterimage packet; historical provenance, not runtime prerequisite

derivation.binary64: Fixed IEEE754 binary64 hex words; exact signed significand*2^exponent interpreted using Python Fraction; expected little-endian hex is integer.to_bytes, not any candidate encoder.
derivation.canonical_bytes: Original fixed fixture values serialized with ASCII lexical keys, exact lowercase C0 escapes and literal scalar Unicode. Whole preference fixtures deliberately use null preset slots; no duplicate implementation of full preset admission.
derivation.u64: Unbounded Python integer exact sums/differences/comparisons supply canonical decimal expected strings with explicit uint64 range rejection.
derivation.paging: Hand-authored immutable creation keys and independent integer sorting; mutable commit fields intentionally disagree.
derivation.types: Explicit Godot type descriptors; future driver must instantiate actual INT/FLOAT/String/StringName/BOOL types, never rely on JSON parser inferred types.
derivation.logical: Revision and copied-boundary recipes are predeclared logical requirements, not observed executions.

budgets: Exact bytes/types/bits/decimal strings/row IDs; no approximate float tolerance or fitted native outputs.
limits: No SQLite, Win32, DB/queue/thread/service, Godot/native/physics execution or consumer imports.
Full presets require source-validator parity, actual physical-key OS roundtrip and complete closed shape/conflict/cap checks. Field witnesses alone never establish complete record validity.
Existing72 design recipes remain untouched and unexecuted; these references supplement exact value semantics.
Root ratification, independent review and checked contract/source-allocation acceptance must precede production consumers.
